plan: Full-site build of the 32 approved non-homepage routes plus promotion of the selected Direction A homepage to /.
precedence: Manifest wins for content. Section refs win for visual language. Page flow wins for transitions. Composition map identifies load-bearing relationships. Extraction plan and NOTES determine image ownership and implementation layers. Generic components provide mechanics only.

batches.scope: Shared data layer (manifest loader, image resolver, blueprint links), shared SiteHeader/SiteFooter, route scaffolding (13 core routes, dynamic /service-area/[city], /design-review/[slug] noindex sheets), app/sitemap.ts from the approved route order, homepage promotion, chooser/variant/site-design removal, lead-form hook generalization (form keys, consent, résumé).

26 section-specific composition owner components under src/components/sections/compositions/, one per approved composition ID, built against the native refs and composition_map contracts. Client islands: LeadForm (all form compositions), FilterableFilmstrip (recent-projects project filters).
Every route renders its exact manifest through PageSections + the composition registry: exact content, exact page-owned assets, band progression, blueprint contextual links, unique metadata/H1.
public/design/pages/<slug>/section_implementation.json for all 32 pages, site_build/page_set.json, site_build/site_build_contracts.json, scripts/verify-build.mjs deterministic verification.

typecheck + production build, verify-build static+served checks, Playwright pass over all 33 routes at 1440x900 and 390x844 (status, single H1, titles, section IDs, overflow, broken images, nav/footer, forms, filters), desktop+mobile captures under qa/ (git-ignored), registry booleans set from evidence, code review + design review, P0/P1 fixes.

city_route_strategy: One dynamic route app/service-area/[city]/page.tsx renders each city's distinct approved manifest (4 archetypes: local-proof-rail, local-ledger-map, local-photo-canvas, local-datum-directory); no copied route files.
form_routing: All lead forms submit through the existing gomega submission hook with per-route form keys; leads route to workorders@tubroconstruction.com. No Buildertrend integration or automatic scheduling is claimed.
